thread:
anya: Quick design review — the audit log 'encryption' legend is confusing customers. They can't tell if a row is encrypted with their KMS or our platform keys. Screenshot attached. cc @dina @sam

sam: Agreed. Right now we just show 'Encrypted' — propose splitting into two chips: 'Encrypted — Redwood-managed' and 'Encrypted — Customer-managed key (KMS)'.

dina: +1. Also we should add a tooltip on hover explaining what 'Customer-managed key' means (short, with link to docs).

marcus: Tiny UX note: region dropdown ordering affects perception here. If EU orgs see US first it looks wrong. For the console we should surface org-default region at top, then alphabetical.

anya: Good call on region ordering — for this change let's keep sorting: org-default first, then alphabetical. That keeps the micro-change scoped.

design-bot: Accessibility check: the lock icon used in the legend at 14px fails contrast tests (approx 2.6:1). We should aim for >=4.5:1 for small icon+text pairs, or increase size/weight. Also recommend adding an aria-label on the chip like `Encryption: Customer-managed key (KMS)`.

sam: Could swap icon color from gray-400 -> gray-700 in light mode and test dark mode equivalence. Also there's no visible keyboard focus on legend chips — keyboard users can't discover the tooltip.

dina: I'll file a tiny PR: change copy, add aria-label, and add focus ring (outline: 2px solid brand) on chip focus. For the tooltip content I'm thinking of a short string:

```
Customer-managed key (KMS) — encryption keys stored in your cloud KMS. See docs for key rotation and audit.
```

sam: Suggest shortening tooltip to reduce cognitive load: "Customer-managed key — key stored in your cloud provider (KMS)". Link to docs from tooltip.

anya: Also prefer spelling out KMS once: 'customer-managed key (KMS)' so non-technical users aren't lost.

marcus: From a product perspective it would be helpful to add a filter in audit logs: 'Key management' with options 'Redwood' | 'Customer-managed (KMS)'. That makes searches explicit. Low lift?

sam: Sounds reasonable. I'll create a ticket and scope it as a small enhancement. Tagging it for sprint 42.

dina: :thumbsup: I'll include accessibility unit tests (axe snapshots) and a screenshot test for dark/light. ETA: EOD tomorrow for PR draft.

anya: One more keyboard nit: region dropdown currently closes when pressing ArrowRight — should stay open and move focus. Filed bug #4571.

design-bot: Reminder from automated checklist: add `role="status"` for live updates when filters change so screen readers get context (short live region text).

marcus: Thanks everyone. Outcome: implement split legend copy, tooltip link, aria-labels, focus ring, adjust icon contrast, add 'Key management' filter, and follow region ordering guidance. Sam will file backlog ticket; Dina will stub PR.

sam: Filing ticket now: PROD-8219. I'll link to this thread and add acceptance criteria.

dina: PR created and linked in ticket. Review welcome.

anya: Great work — moving to close unless any objections. :eyes:
